notes.calculus-section-14-8-1-project-applied-: At each burn, the later stages plus payload are carried as that stage’s payload. Add the three velocity increments with the initial-to-final mass ratio in each logarithm, assuming the stated common c and S and negligible external forces.
notes.calculus-section-14-8-2-project-applied-: Rearrange N_i=T_i/[SM_i+T_(i+1)] using M_i=T_i−T_(i+1), then multiply the three telescoping ratios. Physical stages require1≤N_i<1/S for0<S<1.
notes.calculus-section-14-8-3-project-applied-: For w_i=ln N_i, the objective is3ln(1−S)+Σ[w_i−ln(1−S e^w_i)] with fixed sum v_f/c. Its second derivative isS e^w/(1−S e^w)²>0; equal w_i gives the global minimum.
notes.calculus-section-14-8-4-project-applied-: Let R=(1−S)N/(1−SN) with N=e^(v_f/(3c)). The optimal total launch mass is AR³ and subtracting the payload gives engine-plus-fuel mass A(R³−1).
notes.calculus-section-14-8-5-project-applied-: With S=.2,c=6000mi/h and v_f=17500mi/h, compute N=e^(17500/18000), R=.8N/(1−.2N). Then M₃=A(R−1),M₂=AR(R−1),M₁=AR²(R−1). Mass ratios do not depend on the unit used for A.
notes.calculus-section-14-8-6-project-applied-: Use the same S=.2,c=6000mi/h but v_f=24700mi/h and A=500lb. The geometrically decreasing stage masses again follow R²(R−1),R(R−1),R−1 times A; these are the source’s common pound-based mass ratios.
notes.calculus-section-14-8-1-project-applied-: The common positive head factor H=170−1.6×10^−6Q_T² is fixed at a given total flow. Maximize Σ(a_i+b_iQ_i−d_iQ_i²); interior marginal powers b_i−2d_iQ_i are equal. The negative definite Hessian ensures the unique global constrained maximum, with clipping when a flow bound is active.
notes.calculus-section-14-8-2-project-applied-: Intersect each inequality250≤slope_i Q_T+intercept_i≤cap_i. All-three operation at bound-active totals is possible between the sum of lower bounds750 and upper bounds3445.
notes.calculus-section-14-8-3-project-applied-: At the interior optimum the first-order change vanishes on zero-sum perturbations; the exact quadratic difference is negative. Numeric comparisons also check nearby splits.
notes.calculus-section-14-8-4-project-applied-: For each total, compare the three individual quadratic curves with the constrained all-three maximum. An inactive turbine contributes zero power, not its negative constant intercept. The curves share the same head factor for this total flow; their domain restrictions still apply.
notes.calculus-section-14-8-5-project-applied-: For each feasible pair solve equality of its two marginal quadratic powers with the sum1500. Compare all three pair maxima and the all-three maximum, including fixed operating intercepts only for active turbines.
notes.calculus-section-14-8-6-project-applied-: No pair has enough capacity for3400. The unconstrained optimum exceeds turbine3’s cap. Set Q₃=1225 and equate the remaining marginal powers while Q₁+Q₂=2175; both remain within their limits.
